completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

completed_missions.title: Complete USDT to USDC migration audit, explain backtest delta, repair defects, retest
completed_missions.result: The complete A01-A11 chain passed after repairs. No supported USDT-to-USDC strategy/code defect explains the historic 733-versus-about-203 difference. The dominant difference is the non-equivalent account path: the old USDT reference carried prior equity/positions into the later period, while the later USDT/USDC controls restarted fresh. On the same fresh-start window USDC slightly outperformed USDT. Persistent portfolio drawdown/risk halting explains most rejected entries on the fresh path. Paper/shared-portfolio parity matched exactly under equivalent assumptions.

active_mission.title: V8 final release audit and promotion
active_mission.objective: Release the current V8 15-market product while preserving V6 as the exact frozen ten-coin Core regression anchor. V8 must reuse the V6 Core profiles unchanged, add the five Satellite profiles as a separate layer, activate only NEARUSDC/BCHUSDC for idle-only Shared capital, keep SUIUSDC/UNIUSDC/AAVEUSDC research-only, preserve the modular two-slot 50/50 capital plan, and prove point-in-time three-year Backtest/Paper/Live/UI parity. Code promotion to gpt/usdc-audit is allowed only after same-head A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS. Live activation remains forbidden.
active_mission.last_transition_reason: Architecture was corrected so V6 remains the exact ten-Core regression anchor and V8 is the current 15-market product. Integration #59 passed the strengthened V6/V8 parity and three-year backtest gates; final exact-head release audit is now required.
constraints: V6_COIN_STRATEGY must remain the exact frozen ten-coin Core regression anchor, including its historical version/hash and profile behavior.
V8 is the current product and must reuse all ten V6 Core parameters/policies unchanged.
V8 contains five Satellite profiles, but only NEARUSDC and BCHUSDC may allocate Shared capital. SUIUSDC, UNIUSDC and AAVEUSDC remain research-only.
Satellites may enter only while the Core is completely idle and must yield required capital to executable Core entries at the next executable open.
Configured max capital X derives exactly two equal 50-percent slots. 250/125 and 1000/500 are examples, not product constants.
All trading decisions are point-in-time from finalized 1h bars; execution uses the next available open. Future bars, holdout outcomes and validation results may not steer runtime decisions.
Primary product evidence uses exactly three calendar years ending at the last fully closed UTC hour plus 400 warmup bars before the report start.
Trade count alone can never justify a candidate. Robust PnL, costs, drawdown, occupancy, parity and validation dominate.
Paper/Live/UI must expose V8 roles and routing consistently while preserving fail-closed safety.
A stale but integral paused Paper ledger is a catch-up requirement before Paper resume, not evidence that candidate code is broken. The ledger must never be silently reset.
Promotion requires fresh exact-head A09 QA_PASS and A11 GOVERNANCE_PASS. Promotion changes code only; Live remains disabled and no real/testnet orders are sent.
acceptance: A01 verifies V6-frozen/V8-current architecture, point-in-time methodology, three-year window, research-vs-active Satellite roles and documentation consistency.
A02 reproduces fresh V8 baseline/stress integration evidence and confirms the selected 2x50-percent layout plus 250/1000 modular scaling.
A03 proves Backtest/Paper/Live parity for V8 Core-first idle-only routing, NEAR/BCH entry/horizon rules, next-open preemption and capital sizing.
A04 verifies source UI, browser/build output and shipped bundle expose V8 as current and accurately label all 15 market roles.
A05 verifies persistent Paper SQLite integrity and reports whether catch-up is required before Paper resume without silently resetting state.
A06 runs full regression and proves frozen V6 tests still pass while V8 integration remains green.
A07 verifies current public Binance USDC market/rule availability for the full configured V8 universe and modular tranche sizing.
A08 verifies strategy/risk/no-lookahead invariants and rejects any improvement based only on activity/trade count.
A10 synthesizes every A01-A08 result and routes any blocker to a named repair owner.
A09 emits QA_PASS only if exact-head integration, full regression and UI/product evidence are fresh and all required specialist evidence is present.
A11 emits GOVERNANCE_PASS only after same-head QA_PASS and rejects stale/mixed-commit evidence or implicit Live approval.
After same-head QA_PASS and GOVERNANCE_PASS the exact candidate commit may be promoted to gpt/usdc-audit. Paper migration/catch-up is a separate audited step; Live remains disabled.
